label: dipotassium hydrogen phosphate
definition: A potassium salt that is the dipotassium salt of phosphoric acid.

label: sodium perchlorate
definition: An inorganic sodium salt comprising equal numbers of sodium and perchlorate ions.

label: sn-glycerol 3-phosphate
definition: An sn-glycerol 3-phosphate having unsubstituted hydroxy groups.

label: adenine
definition: The parent compound of the 6-aminopurines, composed of a purine having an amino group at C-6.

label: carnitine
definition: An amino-acid betaine that is butanoate substituted with a hydroxy group at position C-3 and a trimethylammonium group at C-4.

label: stachyose
definition: A tetrasaccharide consisting of sucrose having an α-<small>D</small>-galactosyl-(1→6)-α-<small>D</small>-galactosyl moiety attached at the 6-position of the glucose.

label: 2'-deoxyadenosine
definition: A purine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside having adenine as the nucleobase.

label: maltose
definition: A glycosylglucose consisting of two <small>D</small>-glucopyranose units connected by an α-(1→4)-linkage.

label: D-mannose 6-phosphate
definition: A mannose phosphate in which the phosphate group is attached to position 6.

label: glycine betaine
definition: The amino acid betaine derived from glycine.

label: 6-O-alpha-D-glucopyranosyl-D-fructofuranose
definition: A glycosylfructose that is <small>D</small>-fructofuranose attached to a α-<small>D</small>-glucopyranosyl unit at position 6 via a glycosidic linkage. It is found in honey and sugarcane.

label: 2-dehydro-D-gluconic acid
definition: A ketoaldonic acid that is <small>D</small>-gluconic acid in which the hydroxy group at position 2 has been oxidised to a keto group.

label: 2-oxoglutaric acid
definition: An oxo dicarboxylic acid that consists of glutaric acid bearing an oxo substituent at position 2. It is an intermediate metabolite in Krebs cycle.

label: ceftazidime
definition: A third-generation cephalosporin antibiotic bearing pyridinium-1-ylmethyl and {[(2Z)-2-(2-amino-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)-2-{[(2-carboxypropan-2-yl)oxy]imino}acetamido groups at positions 3 and 7, respectively, of the cephem skeleton.

label: cobalt dichloride
definition: A cobalt salt in which the cobalt metal is in the +2 oxidation state and the counter-anion is chloride. It is used as an indicator for water in desiccants.

label: 4-methyl-2-oxopentanoic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is pentanoic acid (valeric acid) substituted with a keto group at C-2 and a methyl group at C-4. A metabolite that has been found to accumulate in maple syrup urine disease.

label: lithium chloride
definition: A metal chloride salt with a Li(+) counterion.

label: maltotriose
definition: A maltotriose trisaccharide in which the glucose residue at the reducing end is in the aldehydo open-chain form.

label: sodium nitrate
definition: The inorganic nitrate salt of sodium.

label: sodium succinate (anhydrous)
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the disodium salt of succinic acid. The hexahydrate form is used as an ingredient of topical preparations for the treatment of cataract.

label: 2,4-diamino-6,7-diisopropylpteridine
definition: A member of the class of pteridines that is pteridine in which the hydrogens at positions 2 and 4 are replaced by amino groups, whilst those at positions 6 and 7 are replaced by isopropyl groups.

label: ammonium nickel sulfate hexahydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the hexahydrate form of ammonium nickel sulfate.

label: magnesium dichloride hexahydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the hexahydrate form of magnesium dichloride.

label: sodium sulfite
definition: An inorganic sodium salt having sulfite as the counterion.

label: glycine betaine hydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the monohydrate form of glycine betaine.
